claims: As of April 15, 2026, average mortgage rates are in the mid-6% range.
As of April 15, 2026, 30-year fixed rates are around 6.32%–6.42%.
Mortgage rates dipped near 6% in February.
According to a Mortgage News Daily report, the average contract rate for 30-year fixed mortgages is roughly 6.42%.
Other sources show 30-year fixed rates ranging from 6.00% to 6.50% depending on lender fees.
15-year fixed rates are often quoted in the 5.5%–5.75% range.
Recent slight rate declines have sparked a 5% increase in refinance applications.
